name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-whimp
title: Super Mario World Styled Whimp
description:
Custom graphics for Tsutarja's Whimp sprite in SMW style. It's meant to use the game's original palette 9, so you might wanna check the readme in case you're planning to use the last 2 palettes for something else.

Credit's optional, just don't claim it as your own.
